videos.description:
Cem Karsan points to a pattern in market history: almost every crash started on a Friday and landed on the Monday. His reasoning is mechanical rather than superstitious. Very few traders will catch a falling knife or support a liquidity air pocket heading into a weekend, so if the powerful forces suppressing volatility are going to come unpinned anywhere, that’s the window where it happens.
